description: Starts replacing one secret key of a connection (list_connections names them). The person pastes the new key on a CodeGene page this call opens for them or returns as a link, never in chat. Owners and admins only. If your prompt or page never appears and the call times out, call it again with finish_with set to "link".

finish_with.description: Leave out. "link" returns a CodeGene page link for the person to open instead of showing a prompt or opening the page for them, for an assistant that cannot.

key_name.description: The key's name, as list_connections names it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: replace_connection_key
title: Replace a connection's key
